name: oxlint-plugin-arch
description: Configurable architecture rules for Oxlint JavaScript plugins.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run check:examples && bun run check:skill-assets
scripts.check:examples: oxlint examples/minimal.oxlint.config.ts -c examples/minimal.oxlint.config.ts --disable-nested-config && oxlint examples/full.oxlint.config.ts -c examples/full.oxlint.config.ts --disable-nested-config
